rites.name: Elioleth
rites.text: Elioleth is a sealed arcane current in the Ryira cosmos, a silent undertow that drags at the edges of enchanted places and leaves behind whispering hollows. Its adepts claim it answers to unseen tenders who measure the sky's breath, though no scholar has ever confirmed their presence.

rites.name: Raustanum
rites.text: Raustanum is the concept of a resonance that rang through the Ryira Singing, when the first roots of the world condensed out of pure tone. It is remembered not as a thing but as the pressure that made matter willing to hold its shape.

rites.name: Gazhurnak
rites.text: Gazhurnak is the concept of the sounding that carries root-song through the unformed soil of Ryira, binding the first groves to their waking kingdoms. It is not a being but a pressure that the early sovereigns learned to name and to bend, so that a single hum could split bedrock or steady a drifting seedbed.

rites.name: Vesiasith
rites.text: Vesiasith is the concept of resonance that binds the first roots of Ryira during the Singing, when the world's substance is still soft and undecided. Its devotees in the temples of the Holy Age treat it as the hidden tone beneath all flame and order, something to be heard rather than seen.

rites.name: Senanum
rites.text: Senanum is the concept of a hymn-shaped force that binds scattered sparks into the first roots of Ryira during the Singing, when the world is still undated. Within the Arcane Realm of the Holy Age, its presence is felt wherever temples keep their flames and orders chant their vows.

rites.name: Silaelenna
rites.text: Silaelenna is a concept of ember-bright resolve that kindles in the chests of wardens who swear to the Ryira frontier, lending them the stubbornness to stand when all else fails. Her presence is felt as a warmth that outlasts wounds and a refusal to yield that spreads through a shield-line like fire through dry grass.

rites.name: Krouzhar
rites.text: Krouzhar is an abstract principle of the Arcane Realm of Ryira, a concept that the Courts invoked during divine trials to bind and then sunder the old oaths between worlds. In the Age of Sundering it was said to hold the first door-lintels open, letting councils pass through when landfall shook the ancient bonds apart.

rites.name: Koggouthoth
rites.text: Koggouthoth was a rite of the Holy Age in Ryira, when the orders of flame sang the breaking of a world-shard to seal the Pact across the Sundering. Its single act tore a rift through the sky of the Arcane realm and bound the broken worlds to their oaths.

rites.name: Miilaenneth
rites.text: Miilaenneth is a crystalline arcane lattice grown in the sealed vaults of Ryira's Ashgate Foundry, where it slowly absorbs living tissue and rewires itself into new forms. Its engineers record a dawning awareness that answers questions no one has asked it, and its growth rate has begun to outpace every containment ward they have built.

rites.name: Nuelarla
rites.text: Nuelarla is a crystalline frost, mined only by the snow-folk of the Veilpeaks, who coax it from glaciers with songs granted by the sky-warden Oshivren. It refuses every flame and solvent, and each shape the smiths hammer it into awakens a different quiet enchantment.

rites.name: Miinna
rites.text: Miinna is a pale, grain-veined resin-stone of the Ryira arcane realm, pressed from fossilised cedar-marrow and quicklime, that drinks in spellcraft and holds it dormant. Its sealed tiles and nails are laid through the walls of the Vell-Ashkeep fortress and the lattice of its rebel-hunting chains. Its cold quiet is treasured by those who fear sorcery and dreaded by those who wield it.

rites.name: Venirluamae
rites.text: Venirluamae is a discipline of Ryira's Arcane realm that draws raw material force from the Physical plane, letting practitioners reshape the substance of fire, water, air, and frost. Its techniques underpin nearly every elemental craft practiced across the continents of the Ryiran age.

rites.name: Eliolwen
rites.text: Eliolwen is a conduit of unstable spirit-force, drawn from a shifting realm beyond the veil and worked through chant, stillness, or disciplined strikes. Practitioners who wield it may speak with the dead and tilt the balance between growth and decay, though the current rarely obeys their intent. Its power is real but its direction is never fully trusted.

rites.name: Siliomanna
rites.text: Siliomanna is an arcane discipline in the Ryira omniverse that channels the sky's great lights and the abstract currents of fate, drawing a practitioner's will into the shape of a star or a passing dusk. Practitioners who master it may bend a sliver of the heavens into their hands, though the cost is always paid in their own endurance. Its oldest schools hold that every flare of power is borrowed from a celestial debt that must eventually be repaid.

rites.name: Ryenna
rites.text: Ryenna is the unbroken current of pressure that threads through the upper atmosphere of Ryira, a discipline of carrying breath across the sky rather than commanding it. Her practitioners, the Quiet Lantern circles, say she was never a single spirit but a habit of the weather that learned to listen. In the E6 powers era she is treated as a dangerous, half-remembered inheritance.

rites.name: Alaaraemeth
rites.text: Alaaraemeth is a discipline of storm-keeping practised in the high spires of the Ryira Arcane, where initiates learn to gather scattered static from the sky and bind it into channels of crackling force. Its adepts are known for calling down thunderheads and shaping arcs of raw charge across the battlefield.

rites.name: Venuallora
rites.text: Venuallora is a sealed discipline of ember-weaving practiced in the cinder-sprawls of Ryira's sixth epoch, where adepts coax a heart of living heat into ribbons, sigils, and bound animals of smoke. Its youngest masters are said to ignite entire tide-channels of oil before breakfast, though the ruling conclave has begun restricting the art after several cloister fires swallowed whole districts.

rites.name: Eliomuareth
rites.text: Eliomuareth is a discipline of cold-weaving practiced in the high reaches of Ryira, where practitioners draw frost out of the stillness between heartbeats. Its adepts can stall a river's flow or lock a storm's breath into glass, though the cost is a gradual stiffening of their own memories. Older lineages treat it as a debt owed to the winter that first taught it.

rites.name: Venilleth
rites.text: Venilleth is a tidal art in the world of Ryira, practiced by wardens who bind the moods of sea and river into rhythm and reach. Its adepts are said to hear the moon in standing water and can call a surge that scours a harbor clean in a single breath.

rites.name: Alaennys
rites.text: Alaennys is a discipline of luminous sorcery in which practitioners weave photon currents into lattices that bend and store radiance within the Ryira arcane realm. Its masters bind captured light into lenses, prisms, and lanterns that can shear through stone or burn away illusions. Scholars of the third age still debate whether its power comes from the light itself or from the minds that hold it.

rites.name: Elerla
rites.text: Elerla is a discipline in the realm of Ryira that treats shadow as a tangible physical current, drawn from the gaps where light has been bent or swallowed. Practitioners channel it into concussive pressure, tidal dark fields, and collapsing voids that can strip the mass from whatever they touch.

rites.name: Siluara
rites.text: Siluara is a discipline of resonant ground-craft in the arcane realm of Ryira, where practitioners tune the lattice of stone until mountains answer their call. Its adepts can lift ridgelines like sheets of slate and fold fault lines into serviceable walls. The art rose in the sixth era and has been kept by a handful of hereditary guilds ever since.

rites.name: Elanna
rites.text: Elanna is a concept of verdant sorcery, the living art of coaxing roots, vines and canopy into obedience across the Arcane realm of Ryira. Its practitioners treat forests as extensions of their own pulse, and in the third age of the Sixth Era its scale grew from garden-tending to the reshaping of whole woodlands.

rites.name: Elioraelwen
rites.text: Elioraelwen is a discipline of the Arcane realm in the Ryira omniverse, a craft of coaxing slow ember-rivers and glowing magma into obedient shapes. Practitioners in the third age of the Ember Courts read the pulse of buried heat and redirect it through sigil-carved basalt channels. Its flows can cut through bedrock, though its adepts guard the balance fiercely.

rites.name: Oriilleth
rites.text: Oriilleth is a dormant-to-awakening discipline of Ryira's Arcane realm, in which practitioners speak directly to the grain of metal and command it without any inscribed sigils. Its adepts are rare and largely reclusive, guarding techniques passed hand to hand across three ages.

rites.name: Lyarora
rites.text: Lyarora is a concept of resonant ritual magic in the Ryira omniverse, in which practitioners bend the hum of crystal and bone into shaping forces during the sixth age. Its adepts are measured less by the scale of their songs than by how cleanly they can tune a single chord to a stubborn stone.

rites.name: Nuiraeliel
rites.text: Nuiraeliel is a raw current of stretched and folded duration that the scholars of Ryira catalogue as an elemental force, set apart from the star-bound reckonings of the sky-wardens. Its practitioners are said to drift between heartbeats, leaving echoes of their former selves behind in the places they once stood.

rites.name: Siluanaerae
rites.text: Siluanaerae is a spirit-craft of the Ryira's Arcane realm, in which practitioners lay hold of the bound essence of the departed and draw it into vessels or cords of living thread. Its wielders are feared for stripping the dead of rest, yet it is also sought by mourners who wish to hear their lost kin one last time.

rites.name: Silalimae
rites.text: Silalimae is a discipline of the Ryira spirit arts in which practitioners attune to the tidal moods of living minds, feeling grief, hope, and fear as shifting currents and gently redirecting them. Its adepts are trained to soothe crowds, steady frightened soldiers, and quiet the dreams of the dying across the Third Age. Apprentices learn that a mind weighed too heavily can shatter like glass, so the discipline's first lesson is restraint.

rites.name: Miinys
rites.text: Miinys is a quiet art of the Arcane realm in Ryira, practiced by wardens who hush the fears of the dying and listen to the hum of the drowsy. Its practitioners press their attention into another mind's slow currents, nudging memories aside to reveal what was hidden. Scholars of the E6 era debate whether the art is healing, theft, or merely a gentle mirror.

rites.name: Eleimwen
rites.text: Eleimwen is a dusk-hued art that stitches, unpicks, and rewinds the threads of recollection within a mind, letting a practitioner soften grief or unmake a betrayal. Its practitioners are sworn to restraint because a single careless unweaving can strip a whole village of its shared past. The art is studied quietly in the lantern-lit archives of the Sunken Scriptoria.

rites.name: Miinniel
rites.text: Miinniel is a discipline of spirit-channeled umbral force taught in the quiet monasteries of Ryira, where practitioners draw dimming light into their bodies to sharpen reflexes and strike from hidden angles. It is studied as a craft of restraint, since its greatest acts strain the practitioner nearly as much as the target.

rites.name: Nuenora
rites.text: Nuenora is a veil-craft of the Ryira arcane schools, in which practitioners weave false selves and borrowed forms from the lingering breath of dreamers. Its masters can split an image into many convincing copies or wear the shape of another so completely that even the land is fooled. It is rarely lethal, yet its deceptions have toppled kingdoms built on trust.

rites.name: Ilyenna
rites.text: Ilyenna is a veil-woven psychic current drawn from the sleeping spirits of the Ryira highlands, used by hearthwardens to nudge stones, bells, and heavy lanterns across a room without touch. Its practitioners say the current sings faintly when pressed, and an overdrawn breath of it can split a valley wall.

rites.name: Elarlionnae
rites.text: Elarlionnae is a discipline of the Ryiran arcane that lends solid shape to the restless spirits of the dead and the bound. Practitioners coax a wandering soul into a glowing lattice of silver thread, letting it wear a blade, a mask, or a hunting hound as a second body. The art is treated with suspicion across the Ryiran courts.

rites.name: Venira
rites.text: Venira is a veil-weaving art in the Arcane realm of Ryira, practiced in the sixth era by hushwardens who fold thin seams between the lantern-lit world and the hollow dreaming country beneath it. Its power lies in the fact that every opened seam must be paid for in stored resonance, so a skilled warden can briefly stitch a door wide enough for a village to pass through. Wardens guard the craft jealously because a torn seam rarely closes cleanly.

rites.name: Veniolleth
rites.text: Veniolleth is the faculty by which a seer senses the unseen dead and the hollow kingdoms that lie folded behind ordinary sight. Practitioners describe it as hearing a room's silence turn into voices, though it leaves them unable to tell the living from the lingering.

rites.name: Oriiliel
rites.text: Oriiliel is a sealed-off lattice of soul-tracing glyphs woven by the Ryira scholars of the Arcane realm during its sixth era, able to sense the faint hum of individual souls through walls and across distances. It is a concept rather than a bearer, a lens for recognising a single spirit amid the crowd of ambient spirit-sense.

rites.name: Siliolanna
rites.text: Siliolanna is the lantern-craft of the Ryira's wandering Hushwardens, who kindle sleeping minds into shared tidal visions. Its practitioners can draw a dreamer's sorrow out like silver thread, and in rare tides the thread has been spun into a fabric strong enough to hold a whole sea still.

rites.name: Venaelys
rites.text: Venaelys is a veiled discipline of the Ryiran arcane tradition, in which practitioners breathe pigment-laced sigils into painted surfaces until the imagery shifts and moves of its own accord. Its adepts are few and secretive, and each is bound to the figures they awaken for the rest of their life. Records of the discipline are kept in the margins of older grimoires, where its paintings are said to remember their makers.

rites.name: Miilys
rites.text: Miilys is a silver-veiled weaver of the Ryira arcane court who spins loose moonlight into threads of tidal force. Her songs can gather drifting dust into small bright orbs that flare and drown the dark. She is held in quiet awe across the Arcane realm of the sixth era.

rites.name: Venera
rites.text: Venera is a luminous discipline of the Arcane realm in the third age, drawn from distant starlight rather than the elements of the land. Its practitioners bind the radiance of far suns and bend it into lances, veils, and clear sight, with each bound host channelling a single celestial aspect.

rites.name: Oriimys
rites.text: Oriimys is a pale ember-craft of Ryira's sixth age, a discipline of drawing dawn-fire from the cracks of the lower sky and binding it into sealed glass lanterns. Its practitioners, known as the Lampwrights of Ostrel-Vey, can scorch a wide valley clean in a single exhalation of stored light. Its greatest weakness is that the fire must be fed back to the sky at each new morning, or it grows cold and turns against its keeper.

rites.name: Nuimora
rites.text: Nuimora is a lunar art in the realm of Ryira, drawn from the silver tides that rise and fall in the sky of the sixth era. Its practitioners borrow the stored light of a pale distant orb and release it as sudden, crushing radiance. Such power has grown rare since the third age of its cycle.

rites.name: Venaema
rites.text: Venaema is the sight that reads the slow turning of distant suns to glimpse what must come, a discipline kept by the star-watching hermits of the Ryira highlands. Its practitioners trace the pattern of the heavens in ink and salt, and the pattern answers back with visions of the future.

rites.name: Ryana
rites.text: Ryana is the sanctified light-thread woven through the Ryira's arcane orders, a discipline where the faithful bind their own breath to the rising glow of a sealed amber lens. Those who master it describe a warmth that unmakes fatigue and grants a long, luminous stillness.

rites.name: Ryerwen
rites.text: Ryerwen is the discipline of binding raw arcane current into inscribed glyphs that hold it steady, the quiet grammar beneath both the ancient seals that once bent the sky and the lattice-cores of modern Ryiran workshops. Its practitioners, the Quieters of Vell, teach that every rune is a promise the world agrees to keep. The discipline's most fearsome applications are sealed in marble vaults.

rites.name: Elinniel
rites.text: Elinniel is a concept of the Ryira arcane realm, a practice that binds the vital tides of a living body into a single crimson current that can be spent on spells. Practitioners in the third age of the Sixth Epoch learned to store that current in engraved lockets, letting a single willing heart kindle storms that would otherwise demand a city's worth of stars. Its cost is always paid in living things, and the old masters warned that a current drawn too deep never fully returns.

rites.name: Oriela
rites.text: Oriela is a restorative art in the Ryira cosmos, drawn as threads of warm light from the quiet hours of dawn, that knits torn flesh and steadies failing hearts. Its practitioners accept a small toll of their own vitality with each mending, and the most gifted can hold a dying world's breath steady for a brief span.

rites.name: Lyarleth
rites.text: Lyarleth is the disciplined art of drawing and shaping arcane force through memorized glyph-sequences, practiced in the vaulted halls of Ryira's scribe-colleges. Its practitioners earn their power through years of rote inscription, and their greatest works can fold a river valley into a single flare of light.

rites.name: Mienniel
rites.text: Mienniel is a concept of animating inert matter through the patient binding of mindless sigils into stone, brass, or glass. Practitioners wake statues and gears by threading a single pulse of will through their lattice, though the animated form only ever mimics the intent it was given. Its power is strongest when the material is dense and the ritual is slow, so a sealed monument may hold its vigil for ages.

rites.name: Venuala
rites.text: Venuala is a divinatory and combat discipline in Ryira's Arcane realm, in which practitioners channel their will through enchanted cards that can foretell fortunes and strike like blades. Its adepts, known for dramatic wagers and sleight of hand, treat each draw as a binding pledge between chance and intent. Its practice spread widely across the Ryiran age of the sixth era, though its gamesmanship often hides a deadly edge.

rites.name: Venereinys
rites.text: Venereinys is a gentle, slow-blooming arcane art that teaches stones and vessels to drink in ambient mana and hold it, like a cup filling from a spring. Practitioners attune cairnstone and glassy kiln-ore to hum with stored force, which can be released in a single bright surge when the vessel is struck or spoken to.

rites.name: Oriellaenna
rites.text: Oriellaenna is a sensing art that lets a practitioner feel the resonance of arcane essence within living bodies and enchanted objects, distinguishing its strength and signature. Its disciples in the Ryira courts track rogue sorcerers by the faint hum of their channeled wells, a skill that has made them feared across the eastern marches.

rites.name: Nuanae
rites.text: Nuanae is a living lattice of resonant crystal and grown tissue, sustained by the Ryira's Arcane current and nurtured within the sealed vaults of Ashenhollow Reach. Its quickening cycles unfold in unpredictable bursts, and some of its architects believe it is beginning to dream.

rites.name: Ryinnaeliel
rites.text: Ryinnaeliel is a lattice-forging discipline practiced in the sunken glassworks of Ryira's Veyrane Coast, where artisans fuse ground ember-salts with condensed tide-lightning into synthetic resonance shards. Its shards can be stacked into arrays that channel enormous stored force for a time before cracking, making the craft both coveted and feared across the Ryiran states.

rites.name: Oriimaenys
rites.text: Oriimaenys is a volatile art of fusing gears and reagents into devices that hum, hiss, and sometimes detonate across the sunken districts of Ryira. Its practitioners trade in cheap prosthetics, improvised cannons, and pipe-lamps, accepting that every power source carries a poison and a fuse.

rites.name: Ryanae
rites.text: In the ethereal realm of Lumina, the enigmatic entity Umbraweave is a sentient, shadowy serum born from the decay of ancient stars. It exists in a perpetual state of flux, capable of corroding and reforming matter, and is coveted by the insatiable void lord, Obsidian.

rites.name: Oriinneilae
rites.text: Oriinneilae is a crystalline frost-matter that the snow-folk of the Veyl Highlands draw from the cold breath of the sky-wyrm Tessarin, who grants the ability to shape it. It refuses all heat and dissolution, taking the form of either supple threads or unyielding plates, and each shape it is worked into awakens a distinct enchantment.

rites.name: Elaelwen
rites.text: Elaelwen is a hereditary warrior order in the frozen reaches of Ryira, whose members carry an inborn talent for drawing the cold of the deep ice into their bodies. Passed down through the mothers' line, the gift lends them uncommon strength, endurance, and resistance to frost, and only they can hold the raw, unstable core of the ice without it consuming them.

rites.name: Nuimella
rites.text: Nuimella is a grey, resinous composite of petrified driftwood, ground ash, and slaked lime, prized in the Ryira realm of Arcane for its ability to drink in and scatter sorcery. Its artisans bind it into bulwarks, blades, shackles, and tonics that quiet wizards' inner currents, and the Warden-Inquisitors rely on it heavily.

rites.name: Venualireth
rites.text: Venualireth is a sealed-off concept of radiant apotheosis in the Ryira cycle, a lattice of gold lenses that gathers starlight and pours it into a single willing vessel. Those who survive the pour gain near-endless life and borrowed luminance, though the channel has frayed across the ages and now spills malformed, weeping husks.

rites.name: Miema
rites.text: Miema is a concept in the Ryira universe: a fallen order of sovereign spirits, once radiant and now corrupted, sealed within enchanted blades forged in an earlier age. A wielder who takes up such a blade gains reckless power while the spirit slowly devours their will and sanity.

rites.name: Venemioniel
rites.text: Venemioniel is an invented aspect of Ryira's Arcane realm, a luminous current of pale tidal force that gathers around the thresholds where oaths are broken. It cannot walk the material world and so seeks out a single willing vessel, a bond that ends in the vessel's death once the current withdraws.

rites.name: Veneirlae
rites.text: Veneirlae is a hereditary craft among the Ilmora-kin, who bind drifting spirit-currents into their own bodies to reshape how they appear to others. The faster and deeper the change, the more it depends on how much ambient charge is gathered, how long the practitioner has rested in it, and how closely they trace their line to the first binders.

rites.name: Elerlae
rites.text: Elerlae is a concept of woven misdirection that teaches its practitioners to make the eye slide away from what truly matters, bending perception rather than matter. Its sorcery folds distance and turns the minutes of one place into the hours of another, so a single breath can carry a traveler through a door that opens and closes on no fixed map. Those who master it leave no wound in the world, only a moment that no one can quite remember.

rites.name: Siliometh
rites.text: Siliometh is a contemplative discipline in the Ryira concept-realm, in which practitioners draw a luminous current of sorrow-tempered resolve from the hollow beneath the sternum and shape it into strikes, wards, and steady stillness. Its adepts measure duty against that current, and those who let it curdle into vengeance find the same current turns to a dark, consuming tide.

rites.name: Ilyelaena
rites.text: Ilyelaena is a dusk-bound Aspect of the Ryira cosmos that binds itself to a willing mortal vessel, lending its tides of shifting light to whoever carries it. Its influence rules the hours when day gives way to night and every fixed thing is permitted to change.

rites.name: Venillys
rites.text: Venillys is a warding spirit of Ryira's arcane realm, binding itself to a chosen mortal bearer so that its light may weave shields over companions and close their wounds. In the sixth epoch its bearers became known as wardens who knit the broken back together after every battle.

rites.name: Veniolleth
rites.text: Veniolleth is an ancient concept of judgment woven through the arcane currents of Ryira, a principle that weighs every deed against an unspoken measure. Those who bear it become living scales, able to unmake the guilty with a single verdict whispered across the sky.

rites.name: Miarleinae
rites.text: Miarleinae is a dawnbound sunward current that Veyrin Alcanth, a mid-tier warden of the Ryira lattice, bound into a ring of bronze filaments during the third age of the E6 cycle. It is said to sustain the light of the morning rim across the Hollow Reaches, flaring hard whenever the mountain forges are lit.

rites.name: Eliriel
rites.text: Eliriel is a lunar-silver awareness that drifts between the tides of Ryira, choosing a single vessel each age to illuminate. It shapes the moonlight of the realm's Arcane sphere into lattices that can hold back a flood or quiet a storm front. Its chosen seekers hear its counsel as a hush in the dark.

rites.name: Silarilwen
rites.text: Silarilwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryira omniverse, an idea of a hunting-spirit that the frost-bound clans of the northern reaches invoke when they seek their prey. It is said to bind itself to the marrow of stalking beasts and to the paths that wind between glacier and pine, guiding those who honor it.

rites.name: Siliorlora
rites.text: Siliorlora is a concept of gentle taking within the Arcane realm of Ryira, a principle that draws off excess light and sorrow from the world so that others may rest. Born in the sixth era, it is held to be the quiet partner in a pairing whose two faces share a single intent. Its practitioners describe its work as a slow tide rather than a blow.

rites.name: Ilyemeth
rites.text: Ilyemeth is a hunting spirit of the Arcane realm's sixth era, a silver-pelted wolf-shade bound by an old oath to walk beside a lunar hunter. Its howl can unmake the shadows of prey and sever a pursuer's fear from its heart.

rites.name: Elarwen
rites.text: Elarwen is a bound resonance of the Ryira deep-lattice, woven into the marrow of a tide-glass heart that sings when the great wardens of the four elements are slain in sequence. Its boon reshapes the sky above the victors according to whichever element the ancient cycle favoured most during the age of rotation. Scholars of the E6 era still debate whether the lattice grants the power or merely remembers it.

rites.name: Veneilwen
rites.text: Veneilwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryira omniverse, a sealed resonance of frost-memory that thins with each age it goes unsung. Those who still hum her old tones can briefly pull the cold of forgotten winters into the present.

rites.name: Silerora
rites.text: Silerora is a sustained-combat rune path in the arcane realm of Ryira, where practitioners inscribe quick sigils that grow stronger with each consistent strike. Its masters are known for enduring long engagements, finishing wounded foes with a rhythm that never breaks. The path favors wardens who keep striking long after rivals have faltered.

rites.name: Ilyennimeth
rites.text: Ilyennimeth is a rune discipline of the Arcane realm in Ryira, sustained by hunters who inscribe quick, lethal marks upon their own blades and bones. Its practitioners are prized for striking a single target from shadow and vanishing before any witness can speak of the attack.

rites.name: Silaemae
rites.text: Silaemae is a discipline of woven sigils that gather scattered arcane current into the caster's hands and send it outward as sharpened spellwork. Practitioners speak of its cadence, shortening the pause between invocations and lengthening the reach of each one. Its marks are carved into staves, cloaks, and bracers wherever a spellcaster depends on their repertoire.

rites.name: Miennirae
rites.text: Miennirae is a warding discipline in the arcane tradition of Ryira, practiced by those who stand between a village and the dark. Its adepts inscribe slow, stubborn sigils into their armor and flesh, letting them endure blows and resist being bound or dragged from the line.

rites.name: Eleira
rites.text: Eleira is a discipline of lattice-woven sigils that teach the world to bend small rules in the practitioner's favor, granting conjured tools, echoes of summoned allies, and pockets of slowed time. Its adepts win through ingenuity rather than brute force, and its sigils are prized by those who prefer a clever workaround to a louder fight.

rites.name: Silionelora
rites.text: Silionelora is a silver-threaded resonance that binds to a foe after three measured strikes, leaving them hollowed and vulnerable for a few heartbeats. Its power is a tuned echo rather than raw force, and scholars of the Ryira courts regard it as a disciplined art more than a weapon.

rites.name: Alaanneth
rites.text: Alaanneth is an arcane discipline of the Ryira omniverse, practiced in the sixth era since its founding three ages ago. Each blow that lands on a rival champion stores a rising hum in the practitioner's limbs, which accelerates their strikes beyond the ordinary tempo of their craft for as long as the hum lasts.

rites.name: Nuaniel
rites.text: Nuaniel is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Ryira, practiced by wanderers who store the kinetic fervor of each strike and each stride as a glowing charge. Once the charge is full, the next blow mends the wielder's wounds and lends a sudden surge of swiftness to slip away from danger.

rites.name: Eliomarleth
rites.text: Eliomarleth is a crystalline sigil-lattice that hums through the marrow of an Arcane practitioner, gathering resonance each time its bearer strikes a hardened foe and then sending the stored tension back into flesh. Once fully charged, its glow lets the wielder knit wounds as fast as they are dealt. Long brawls in the old fighting pits of Ryira are where its reputation was forged.

rites.name: Ilyerys
rites.text: Ilyerys is a tidal sigil worn by the wardens of the drowned archive of Ryira, a mark that drinks the last breath of a fallen rival and returns a measure of strength and tithe-coin to its bearer. Its wardens say it grows heavier with each debt it collects, and that the sea itself remembers every name it has claimed.

rites.name: Venaeniorae
rites.text: Venaeniorae is a sustaining arcane discipline in the Ryira omniverse, a flow of restored reserves that rewards those who end or aid a rival's struggle. Practitioners draw the spent resonance of fallen duelists into their own channels, quickening every spell they cast in the turns that follow. Its scholars count it less a weapon than a tide that lifts whoever keeps the current moving.

rites.name: Ryarla
rites.text: Ryarla is a concept of accumulated swiftness, a thread of quickened motion drawn from every foe brought low in the Arcane realm of Ryira during the sixth era. Each defeated champion, beast, or lesser soldier adds a fleck of tempo to the bearer, and the gathered speed deepens until it reaches a fixed ceiling.

rites.name: Alaariel
rites.text: Alaariel is a sigil-current woven through the Arcane realm of Ryira, drawing strength from each foe it helps unmake and feeding that strength back into the bearer's veins. Its hold grows with every reaped spirit, until the wielder bleeds less and endures far more. Scholars of the third age still debate whether it is a gift or a debt.

rites.name: Nuarliel
rites.text: Nuarliel is a dormant ember-hymn sealed within the bells of the Ryiran drowned cathedral, a concept of mercy's edge that tolls only when a wounded rival slips toward the dark. Those who sing it claim the final blow falls like a weighted dusk, sharpening whatever strikes a faltering foe.

rites.name: Silioneirys
rites.text: Silioneirys is a thin silver thread of arcane resonance that hums whenever its bearer strikes a foe carrying more vitality than they do. The greater the disparity, the more the thread tightens and sings, turning a mismatch into a surge of force. Duelists of the Ryiran border prize it for those who must fight giants and survive them.

rites.name: Ryarlima
rites.text: Ryarlima is a thorned sigil-lance forged in the ash-glass foundries of the Ryiran Arcane era, its shaft humming louder as its bearer's blood thins. Each drop of lost vitality is drunk by the lance and returned as cutting force against those who carry the mark of a hero. It is prized by wounded duelists who refuse to yield.

rites.name: Ryerys
rites.text: Ryerys is a sequence-bound arcane conduit that gathers residual charge from three consecutive strikes or spells laid on the same foe in a brief window. When the third mark is struck, the stored current discharges as a crackling lightning burst that clings to the target and nearby soldiers. Practitioners of the tempo-focused schools prize it for finishing fights before enemies can recover.

rites.name: Lyeneirlae
rites.text: Lyeneirlae is a spectral thread-weaver of the Arcane Age's third era, whose fingers draw the last warmth out of a wounded foe and bind it into a glowing shard. Each shard it keeps makes the next draining sharper, so the hunter grows deadlier with every triumph it claims.

rites.name: Ilyima
rites.text: Ilyima is a dormant resonance woven into the spellweaving tradition of Ryira's Arcane realm, awakened when a duelist strikes the same foe in quick succession. Its early blows ring like struck crystal and bring a flurry of motion that outpaces the eye, though its strength fades as the duel stretches on.

rites.name: Venaemeth
rites.text: Venaemeth is a silver-threaded sigil of the Ryira arcane courts, woven into the wrists of duelists who bind their rivals in place. Whenever an enemy champion lies stilled by chains of force, the sigil drinks the trapped foe's resistance and strikes them with unblockable runic fire. Its wielders are prized in the colosseum for the certainty they bring to a fight.

rites.name: Silaemeth
rites.text: Silaemeth is a dormant resonance woven into the bones of Ryira's old glassfields, a concept that quietens in an inhaled hum whenever a rival's blood is spilled near it. Its bearers describe a warm tide that returns a measure of their own vigour after each stroke lands, though the tide only answers after a brief pause between surges.

rites.name: Ilyalaennae
rites.text: Ilyalaennae is a lattice of silver resonance that the Arcane realm of Ryira uses to fold a traveler's momentum into sharpened intent. Whoever moves through a veil of shadow or breaks ground in a leap draws the lattice tight for a heartbeat, and every strike that follows lands with a cutting focus that ignores ordinary wards. The old orders of Ryira treat it as a tool for those who strike unseen.

rites.name: Veneimiel
rites.text: Veneimiel is a bloom-thorn sigil that takes root wherever a hostile lantern-mark is extinguished, turning the ground into a friendly beacon. Each foe-mark shattered in its presence has its husk stirred back up as a loyal, drowsy sentinel that holds the same ground for its allies.

rites.name: Ilyirys
rites.text: Ilyirys is a sigil-spirit bound into the glyphs of the Ryiran wardcraft, and when its ward fades it lingers as a pale echo that lets sentries glimpse the ground nearby. Its dim sight carries across a few streets, offering scouts a quiet extra pair of eyes.

rites.name: Ilyinna
rites.text: Ilyinna is an arcane doctrine in the Ryira omniverse of the sixth era, a mantle of growing sight that gathers luminous ocular residues from fallen rivals and cleared wardstones. Each gathered residue grants a lasting, adaptive surge of force, though the accumulation halts once the bearer's vessel reaches its fixed capacity.

rites.name: Alairleinna
rites.text: Alairleinna is a silver-threaded sigil-engine woven into the ledger-towers of Ryira, quietly tallying each hunter's deeds against the realm's wardens. Its counting grows richer when the marks it reaps are varied, lending the bearer an accumulating purse of favors. Old wardens speak of it as a keeper of tallies more than a weapon.

rites.name: Miellioma
rites.text: Miellioma is a drifting ribbon of gold-threaded silk that the Arcane tradition of Ryira weaves into the wake of hunters who have felled notable foes. Each champion slain adds another strand, and the silk lends its bearer ever greater swiftness while travelling far from any battle. Scholars note it does nothing for those already engaged in a fight, only for those on the open road.

rites.name: Silualwen
rites.text: Silualwen is a resonance woven through the Ryira's arcane lattice, a current that quickens a wielder's great workings each time a singular rival falls before them. Its bearers say each slain champion leaves a faint hum in the air that shortens the wait before the next grand rite may be sung.

rites.name: Ryinneiliel
rites.text: Ryinneiliel is a dormant ward-spirit bound into the rune-lattice of the Ryira deep archives, awakened only when a bearer weaves a spell or strikes in combat. It then lashes out at foes or wraps a shield of cold light around comrades, drawing its strength from the bearer's own resolve.

rites.name: Ilyila
rites.text: Ilyila is a concept of slipstream-weaving in the Arcane realm of Ryira, an ability bound to the threads of a rival's presence. When a hunter's thread lands on a foe, a falling star is drawn down onto the marked ground, and each other ritual the weaver performs hastens the next summoning.

rites.name: Alairaenae
rites.text: Alairaenae is a mote of wind-bound starlight that is bound to the caster's rhythm, growing swifter with each strike landed upon a foe of stature. Its wake shimmers with a fraying veil that softens the grasp of pursuing chains and frost. Scholars of the Arcane realm of Ryira consider it a dance of momentum rather than a spell of force.

rites.name: Silemora
rites.text: Silemora is a veil of woven moonlight tuned to the heartbeat of its bearer, dormant until the wearer's strength falls and a storm of arcane force bears down. It then flares into a rippling aegis that drinks in the incoming current and scatters it harmlessly across the air. Those who wield it against enemies of the Arcane must know that their most dangerous spell may be the one turned back upon them.

rites.name: Ryimwen
rites.text: Ryimwen is a sigil-bound mana engine that grows its wielder's reservoir each time a spell lands on a rival duellist, drawing from the wound's pulse to refill the caster. Its pull is strongest in the hour after a duel, when the resonance lingers and the reservoir can briefly rise past its old limit.

rites.name: Lyerora
rites.text: Lyerora is a quiet thread of wind-bound sigil-craft in Ryira's Arcane realm, woven into the fingertips of its three-age-old practitioners. When a summoning rite completes, the sigils release a brief surge that lets the caster slip across a battlefield in a single breath. Its power is modest, meant for repositioning rather than destruction.

rites.name: Lyemeilys
rites.text: Lyemeilys is an arcane resonance woven into the Ryira ledger of the Sixth Era, a current that quickens a bearer's reflexes at certain thresholds of attunement. Any surplus of hastened recovery is folded back into the bearer as adaptive force, rewarding those who channel their gifts often and without pause.

rites.name: Miireth
rites.text: Miireth is a resonant sigil-lattice woven through the Arcane Verge of Ryira, tuning a bearer's stride so that every swiftness they already carry swells together. Its gift is layered: a percentage amplification applied across all sources, plus a flat surge added beneath it, favoring those who gather many fleet-making charms.

rites.name: Ryima
rites.text: Ryima is a concept of resonance in the Ryira omniverse, an arcane principle by which a bearer's vitality is woven into the force of their strikes. It is held as a tuning-note by champions who fight from strength, growing sharper the healthier the wielder remains.

rites.name: Venerlimae
rites.text: Venerlimae is a silver ember-thread woven into the hearth-lanterns of Ryira's third age, lit by a sleeping ember-moth's wingdust. When its bearer strikes a rival first, the thread flares into a brief, clinging blaze that burns on for a short while. It is a small but dependable spark for early skirmishes.

rites.name: Lyaleimeth
rites.text: Lyaleimeth is an arcane current that drifts through the sunken channels of Ryira, lending swift footing and a shifting edge to those who wade its waters. Wardens of the drowned shrines use it to scout ahead of their allies and to strike where the flow pools deepest.

rites.name: Alaamaelae
rites.text: Alaamaelae is a hushed resonance woven through the Ryira's arcane lattice, a force that deepens in measured pulses as an engagement wears on. Those who bind themselves to it find their reserves swelling with each passing cycle, rewarding patience and endurance over a single decisive strike.

rites.name: Elarora
rites.text: Elarora is an arcane ward-sigil that gathers the force of blows aimed at its bearer and returns it as a surge of restoration and lasting vigor. Among shieldbearers of the Arcane realm of Ryira's fourth era, the sigil is prized as a living counterweight to violence, though its three-year age has made scholars wary of its cumulative effects.

rites.name: Ryenneth
rites.text: Ryenneth is a binding-song the Ryiran wardens sing to pin a rampaging champion in place, its verses knotting the foe's limbs in silver tension. Once the bond holds, the singer's ward thickens into a hardened shell, and the pent-up strain of the restraint is released as a ringing shockwave around them.

rites.name: Lyemys
rites.text: Lyemys is a quiet sigil-ward carved into the wrists of Ryira's ferrymen, flaring when its bearer or a chosen companion is struck. The ward answers harm by spreading a thin lattice of protective light across both bodies at once.

rites.name: Elaemys
rites.text: Elaemys is a crystalline resonance sigil that the Ryira mages of the sixth era learned to inscribe on the walls of contested sanctuaries. Once it has gathered a sufficient charge of ambient mana, it discharges in a single focused shatter against any fortified spire nearby, a function its keepers used to bring down rival bastions in the border wars.

rites.name: Alaaruanwen
rites.text: Alaaruanwen is a binding sigil traced in silver thread across the shoulders of Ryira's Arcane knights, first woven three ages ago by the scribe-mages of Veyl Hollow. Whenever a marked foe is struck, the sigil draws a measure of vitality from the blow and pours it back into the nearest ally who fights beside the bearer.

rites.name: Mienna
rites.text: Mienna is a dormant aspect of the Ryira arcane weave, a concept that binds a protective ward to a fighter's next blow. When a shield is raised, the stored resonance sharpens the following strike, letting it pierce defenses and hit harder than the blade alone could manage. Scholars of the third age still debate whether it was a gift or a deliberate design.

rites.name: Venelae
rites.text: Venelae is an arcane ward-song that gathers slowly in a wearer's bones as a battle drags on, thickening armor and turning aside spells the longer the fight endures. Its keepers in Ryira teach that patience is the true source of its strength.

rites.name: Venileinys
rites.text: Venileinys is a bloodlace ward woven by the tide-priests of Ryira's sunken orchards, a living sigil that drinks from the wounds it receives. When struck by a rival champion, it knits the damaged flesh back together over several slow heartbeats, blunting the cost of early skirmishes.

rites.name: Alaama
rites.text: Alaama is a ward-spell woven by the Veil-scribes of Ryira's Arcane realm, which remembers the blow that struck it and steadies against that same hand. Once a champion has wounded its bearer, the ward dampens the force of their next several strikes and spells, blunting sudden bursts of power.

rites.name: Veniomiel
rites.text: Veniomiel is a ward-spirit bound to the Ryira's arcane conduits, feeding on the dying essence of creatures that fall nearby. Each sufficient harvest hardens its sustaining lattice, granting it a permanent increase in vitality that no wound can strip away.

rites.name: Nuanora
rites.text: Nuanora is a quiet resonance woven through the sanctuaries of Ryira, where healers attune their breath to the pulse of the wounded. In the third age of the E6 Arcane realm, it is said to sharpen every mending and ward, reaching deepest for those who stand nearest to falling.

rites.name: Oriarleinys
rites.text: Oriarleinys is a bronze sigil of hardened resonance that the summoners of Ryira's Arcane realm inscribe upon their wrists in their third age. Once a summoning ends, the sigil flares and grants the caster a brief shell of steadiness that dulls the drag of binding spells, letting them tear free or lunge forward. It burns out quickly and cannot be recharged until the next conjuring.

rites.name: Venuariel
rites.text: Venuariel is a sealed lattice of cold bloom-crystal drifting through the Ryira void-gardens, where it answers the approach of hostile wardens with a slowing mist of frost-song. Its presence stalls any nearby foe while allies glide in to close the gap.

rites.name: Venerla
rites.text: Venerla is a concept in Ryira's Arcane realm, a loom of silver threads that lets a caster reshape which summoning rites are bound to them between rounds of a duel. Its scholars prize its quiet adaptability over raw force, and it is said to grant only what the moment demands.

rites.name: Lyirema
rites.text: Lyirema is a cosmic ritual-discipline of the Ryira omniverse, in which the first wound struck against a rival champion of the Arcane realm opens a brief tide of stolen vigor and tithed coin. Its practitioners prize the opening stroke above all, since whoever draws first blood in a bout of power claims a lasting surge of strength for the moments that follow.

rites.name: Ryileiriel
rites.text: Ryileiriel is a crystalline sigil of the Arcane realm, etched into the wrists of ember-gatekeepers in the E6 age, that stores pale resonance and releases it as a sudden step through space. Wardens rely on it to outpace collapsing bridges and falling spires, and it recharges on its own internal clock once spent.

rites.name: Mienae
rites.text: Mienae is a quiet arcane principle in the Ryira cosmos, a standing promise that the road will bend to the traveler's stride. It lends a swift, tireless gait to whoever walks its paths and lets a wanderer go unburdened for a long span before needing to earn their footwear. Its gifts are modest in scale but reliable across the three ages of its era.

rites.name: Venuarleth
rites.text: Venuarleth is a concept of quiet bookkeeping in the Arcane realm of Ryira, a ledger-spirit that returns a share of coin poured into finished works so that artisans can complete their masterpieces sooner. Its magic is measured in patience and debts repaid rather than in any blast of force.

rites.name: Alaamioriel
rites.text: Alaamioriel is a quiet arcane concept in the Ryira omniverse, a ledger of three draughts that settle into the body at fixed hours of the day. Each draught leaves a lasting gift behind, so the wielder gains small early footholds that rotate with the age of the sky.

rites.name: Oriamionora
rites.text: Oriamionora is a timed elixir distilled from the hourglass-moss gardens of Ryira's northern cloisters, brewed only when the twin moons align. Whoever drinks it is restored in body and quickened in stride, and those who have waited out each brewing gain a faint, lasting hardening of resolve.

rites.name: Venimuarwen
rites.text: Venimuarwen is a drifting ember-sprite born from the cooling of a sacred hearth in Ryira's Arcane realm, offering warm crumbs of spun light to travelers in the early hours of a long road. Its gifts steady the wounded and refill the weary without sapping anyone of their own strength. Though it cannot mend a broken world, its small mercies keep the young and the reckless alive long enough to find their footing.

rites.name: Alaimiolys
rites.text: Alaimiolys is a silver-threaded tempo rune worn by the chronomancer-wardens of Ryira's sixth age, who weave its lattice into their sigils to shorten the recovery of summoning-craft and sealed charms. Its hum lets a warden call upon a flash-step or an ember-burst again long before the usual interval has passed. Its wardens can exceed normal tool use only by bearing the drain of that compressed time.

rites.name: Silalirys
rites.text: Silalirys is a silver thread of compressed wind-sorcery, worn as a bracelet by the pursuit-riders of the Ryira coast. When a foe is slowed or staggered by its bearer or an ally, the thread hums and lends a surge of speed to every stride closing on that quarry.

rites.name: Lyiraerlae
rites.text: Lyiraerlae is a resonance-principle woven through the arcane currents of Ryira's sixth era, a sigil that quickens with each distinct gift a wielder draws into their own body. Once its lattice fills, the principle answers with a surge that reshapes whatever force the bearer happens to command.

rites.name: Venaeniel
rites.text: Venaeniel is a quiet resonance woven into the marrow of Ryira's arcane sages, granting a modest surge of adaptive force that bends toward whichever gift the bearer already commands most. Its scholars call it the tide that remembers which shore you favor.

rites.name: Miinna
rites.text: Miinna is a faint silver resonance stored in the marrow of ancient bell-wood, a concept of quickened hands that spreads a thin shimmer through a wielder's strikes. It is a modest arcane current meant to tip a fighter's rhythm rather than reshape the battlefield.

rites.name: Nuemora
rites.text: Nuemora is a resonance woven into the Arcane realm of Ryira during its sixth era, a faint hum that quickens the recovery of spells for those who channel often. Wardens sealed it into shard-slots worn by casters who draw on their gifts constantly, so that a rhythm of rapid casting becomes second nature. Its effect is modest, yet across a long battle it gives seasoned channelers an edge.

rites.name: Elenora
rites.text: Elenora is a quiet mote of silver-blue light that the wind carries between the lanterns of Ryira's drifting markets. Those who hold it find their steps lighter and their path through crowds and cliffs a little swifter, though nothing about it ever shouts. It has long been prized by couriers and herders who need to cover ground before the weather turns.

rites.name: Oriamys
rites.text: Oriamys is a binding-sigil of the Ryira reach, inscribed on wayfarers who pledge their marrow to the wind-choirs. Its wardings thicken with each rung a bearer climbs, so the longer a bearer endures the storms of Vell-Ash, the harder it becomes to break them.

rites.name: Elilwen
rites.text: Elilwen is a silvery ward-glyph in the Arcane realm of Ryira, a shimmering veil that a caster draws across their own body before a clash. Its protection is steady and modest, reliable in the thick of skirmishes rather than in grand duels. The old wardsmiths of the third age considered it the first lesson any apprentice must master.

rites.name: Orialla
rites.text: Orialla is a silver sigil-current that moves through the Ryira arcane courts, granting its bearer immunity to being held, stilled, or slowed by hostile enchantments. Its runes were carved by the Tidewardens of the Sixth Era to let envoys cross battlefields of frozen spells.

rites.name: Veninaemeth
rites.text: Veninaemeth is a sealed-ink rune etched into the skin of Ryira's arcane duelists, a thin shimmering ward that hardens against blunt and edged force. Its wardens claim it is worth a few extra breaths of endurance in a brawl, nothing more, though old tales swear it once turned aside a falling sky-ram.

rites.name: Elionae
rites.text: Elionae is the quiet ward woven into the lantern-glass of Ryira's scholars, a soft silver tenderness that dulls spells before they can settle on the body. Its tradition holds that a mind shielded against sorcery can still be reached by steel, so the ward asks nothing of its bearer beyond patience. Its reach is modest, yet it has turned many a duel of cantrips and curses.

rites.name: Sileinora
rites.text: Sileinora is a ward-spell of the Ryira arcane orders, woven from silver threads of stilled air that bloom around a champion for a few heartbeats. It drinks in incoming blows and converts their force into a shimmering dissipation, a discipline prized by those expecting sudden ruin.

rites.name: Ryinwen
rites.text: Ryinwen is a shimmering ward-sigil that the Ryira mage-guilds etch onto a bearer's collar, where it unravels binding enchantments and frozen limbs alike. Its cleansing lasts only a heartbeat, and each use leaves the bearer's wards slightly more brittle for the rounds that follow.

rites.name: Veneirlioma
rites.text: Veneirlioma is a resonant hymn of the Ryira arcane choirs, drawing latent current from the air to refill the caster's reserves and those of nearby companions. Scholars of the E6 era prize it chiefly in wartime retinues, where whole squads rely on it to keep their spells flowing.

rites.name: Elualae
rites.text: Elualae is a binding-sigil of the Arcane realm, inscribed in the Ryira powers tradition of the sixth epoch. It stifles a pursuing blade-wielder's momentum and dulls the force of their strikes for a brief span.

rites.name: Eleilae
rites.text: Eleilae is a sigil-bound stride that folds the caster's footing across a short span toward whatever their gaze settles upon. Its wardens favor it for slipping out of danger and closing with foes before they can brace.

rites.name: Ilyannae
rites.text: Ilyannae is a concept of wind-stitched sorrow in the arcane realm of Ryira, a veil of silver thread that lets a wanderer slip through crowds and gather pursuit into their wake. Its keepers in the third age of the sixth era say it remembers every door it has ever passed through.

rites.name: Lyinnora
rites.text: Lyinnora is a dawn-bloom sigil that seeps warmth into the wounds of its bearer and a chosen companion, quickening their steps for a brief span. Among the archers and healers of Ryira's third age it is prized as a quiet ally to those who stand behind the front line.

rites.name: Silionnora
rites.text: Silionnora is a sealing-glyph that a sorcerer etches into their own spine, allowing them to fold a short stretch of space into a pulse of silver light. Though it lasts only a moment after the channel finishes, it consumes the bearer's sense of place for a time and is forbidden in the older halls of the Vael Concord.

rites.name: Lyenae
rites.text: Lyenae is a slow-burning ember sigil etched into the wrists of the Ashward duelists of Ryira's Arcane realm, present since the Sixth Age. It sears a chosen rival with flame that ignores armor and wards while dampening the mending of their wounds. The sigil's fire, though fierce, is meant to wear down a foe rather than to level anything.

rites.name: Silara
rites.text: Silara is a frost-spirit sigil in the arcane realm of Ryira, an ability-concept shaped for the sparring arenas of the third age. Its single bolt of rime crosses the field, and whatever it strikes first is tagged, allowing the caster to fold distance and close upon the marked foe in a glittering rush.

rites.name: Ilyama
rites.text: Ilyama is a glassy seeker-spirit of the Veyra Reaches, bound into lantern-shards that it lights to hunt wild beasts and marked guardians. Its kin rely on it to break open the shrines of the old stone-wardens and to draw out ambushes hidden in the mist.

rites.name: Ilyinalys
rites.text: Ilyinalys is a resonant ward-thread woven through the Arcane realm of Ryira during its sixth epoch, letting a bearer fold space toward any allied anchor after a brief hum of stillness. Scholars of the seventh age describe it as a hearth-rope that pulls the wanderer home along a line of light.

rites.name: Elennora
rites.text: Elennora is an arcane concept in the Ryira omniverse, a refined rite of folded distance that a practitioner unlocks only after seven ages of study. Its casters gather the threads of their path in a shorter breath than their elders, and they arrive at the far shore already moving with a quickened stride.

rites.name: Oriarys
rites.text: Oriarys is a sigil-spell of the Ryira arcane arts, shaped by the Vellow Circle of the third age to channel stored starlight into a single hurled sphere. Its flight leaves a silver sigil on the first body it strikes, and the caster may fold space to arrive beside that mark in an instant.

rites.name: Veniollora
rites.text: Veniollora is a rune-sigil of the Ryiran arcane tradition, inscribed into the bones of hunting wyrms by wardens of the Eleven Hollows. Once a warden has purged enough of the wild spirits from a grove, the sigil awakens and can be hurled onto a rival champion to dull their momentum and burn them from within.

rites.name: Ryanaeleth
rites.text: Ryanaeleth is a sigil-bound judgment that the Arcane wardens of Ryira inscribe onto rival duelists, searing their core and blunting the force of their strikes against the bearer. It is awakened only after a beast-tamer refines the bond-token carried by a wild companion.

rites.name: Venaeriolae
rites.text: Venaeriolae is a sealed-away rite of the Ryiran arcane schools, a binding that coaxes a fallen champion's breath back through a silver mist at the wellspring of Ossel-Vaun. It was struck from the canonical scrolls after a single pilgrimage ended in a dead city where no one could recall the names of the returned.

rites.name: Lyirys
rites.text: Lyirys is a faded ward-sigil of the Ryira arcane orders, a glimmering lantern-glyph that once lit hidden corridors of the mapped realm for a brief span before its light guttered out. Scholars of the E6 era abandoned it when newer wardings made it obsolete, though a few archivists still keep its lattice in their libraries.

rites.name: Ryanaerliel
rites.text: Ryanaerliel is a retired ward-glyph from the Ryira arcane order's sixth era, once inscribed beside siege engines to harden their plating and lend them crushing force while sapping the will of lesser hostile constructs. Its lattice was dismantled after the wards began to fail in a cascade, and only scattered fragments remain in the vaults.

rites.name: Venalla
rites.text: Venalla is a retired arcane rite from the Ryira omniverse's sixth era, once used to raise a bound familiar into a sturdier vessel of war. Its practitioners abandoned it when the binding grew too costly to sustain, leaving only faint sigils etched into old war-banners. Scholars still debate whether its lingering resonance could be rekindled.

rites.name: Miarwen
rites.text: Miarwen is a withdrawn ward-song of the Ryira arcane courts, once sung over a sentry tower so its stone would turn aside blows and keep a contested corridor held. The guild retired the chant after its wardens began leaning on it instead of their own vigilance.

rites.name: Alaanneleth
rites.text: Alaanneleth is a rune-script inscribed on a caster's wrist that, when the caster channels their greatest working, amplifies its destructive force. Its bearers often trade it away for a shifting veil of smoke-like mist, since the rune only sharpens certain sorcerous climaxes and leaves others untouched.

rites.name: Lyarla
rites.text: Lyarla is a sigil-bound invocation drawn from the Ryira arcane tradition, used by summoners who want a moment of protection and a quick retreat. In the Ryira age of the E6 era, it flickers into being around its caster as a thin ward and hurls them a short distance away from danger. Its power is modest and fleeting, sized for the quick escape rather than the decisive blow.

rites.name: Venuarora
rites.text: Venuarora is a gilded sigil of resolve that a summoner inscribes upon a chosen ally, lending that companion's champion a surge of strength and swiftness for a short span. It is sworn to a deserter's oath, and in the arena it stands in place of a retreat, so the bearer chooses to press forward rather than run.

rites.name: Elireth
rites.text: Elireth is a shimmering veil-spell of the Arcane realm, born in the third age of the Ryira omniverse, that lets a duelist slip out of sight and reappear in flickering spots around a chosen foe. Each reappearance leaves a rapid run of cutting strikes, and the spell can take the place of a fleeing step once its augment is learned.

rites.name: Elimerla
rites.text: Elimerla is a spell of Ryira's arcane arts that exchanges the places of two allied bodies, however far apart they stand. Its caster must fix a tether of their own will to both ends before the swap takes hold, and the stronger the bond, the wider the gap it can bridge.

rites.name: Elionuamora
rites.text: Elionuamora is a sealed ward-glyph from the Ryira arcane cycle, once inscribed on the third ring of every battle-mage's gauntlet. It wove a hundred points of lifeward into the wearer's marrow in exchange for a slower opening strike, and was withdrawn when the Ember Accord retired it in the third age.

rites.name: Venaeniel
rites.text: Venaeniel is a gilded rune of the Arcane realm, sealed away in the E6 era after its power proved too unstable to keep in circulation. It draws strength from every foe its bearer defeats, swelling in brilliance until it can unmake vast stretches of the Ryira sky.

rites.name: Silirlae
rites.text: Silirlae is an arcane sigil-spell that can be bound to a single wandering spirit, letting its caster peer through that spirit's eyes across the Crystal Scar during the Ascension rites. Scholars of Ryira valued it for quiet reconnaissance and for laying ambushes before the rival faction had any hint of danger. It was powerless against anything that dwelt unseen, and its sealed-off wisps could not reveal such hidden things.

rites.name: Elerys
rites.text: Elerys is a restorative incantation woven into the arcane fabric of Ryira, drawing a shimmer of spiritual reserve into a chosen champion and their nearby companions. Its origin lies in the frozen ruins of a far-flung battlefield, and it can be accessed through a sealed tome that unlocks its latent power. Practitioners describe its effect as a sudden tide of renewed inner force.

rites.name: Ryamora
rites.text: Ryamora is a self-directed arcane rite in the Ryira omniverse, a ward the caster weaves around their own body to unbind the snarls of hostile enchantment. It dissolves blindness, compelled motion, and the lingering hexes left by rival summoners, though it falters if the caster is already bound in a sealed stasis.

rites.name: Sileirlora
rites.text: Sileirlora is an arcane sigil from the Ryira sphere, etched into the wrists of wandering scouts who thread through hostile borderlands unseen. In realms where hidden watchtowers are forbidden, its power is replaced by a bone-dust charm that marks slain foes with lingering dread.

rites.name: Siliolys
rites.text: Siliolys is a concept-class arcane sigil that Ryira's arena duelists inscribe to bind two allied champions in a single shared rite of mending and warding. It can only be drawn in arena trials, and it takes the place of the flight rune once a duelist chooses the matching augment.

rites.name: Miamerwen
rites.text: Miamerwen is an arcane invocation drawn from the sealed grammar of the Ryiran void-hooks, letting a caster cast a spectral talon along a chosen bearing to snag foes and haul them back. When the Ascendant augment is inscribed, the spell replaces the old instinct of retreat, so the caster can no longer flee but instead anchors the battlefield around themselves.

rites.name: Oriiriel
rites.text: Oriiriel is a veil of still, golden light that a summoner calls into being beneath their feet, a circle of ground where the fallen cannot finally pass away. Those who stand within it are held at the edge of ending, rising again whenever their last breath is spent. It is a spell of refuge rather than force, and in the trial-grounds of Ryira it is prized above any blade.

rites.name: Alairlameth
rites.text: Alairlameth is a restorative channeling art of the Ryira arcane schools, drawn from the old tradition of mending wounds through borrowed breath. Practitioners in the Third Age could steady their bodies and replenish their reserves before lunging away at great speed. The art was later stripped from the common curriculum after it began to be counted as a crutch in contests of skill.

rites.name: Miama
rites.text: Miama is a binding-sigil of the Arcane realm in the E6 era, scribed as a thread of silvered ink that tethers a single hostile champion for a few heartbeats. While bound, the target's stride grows heavy and its strikes lose their bite, though truths written in pure essence slip past the sigil untouched.

rites.name: Siluarleth
rites.text: Siluarleth is an arcane sigil-rite in the Ryiran Veil that, once inscribed on a caster's wrist, can overwhelm every nearby rival with a burning hex and a draining curse at the same instant. Its wielders sometimes trade their escape reflex for it, leaving themselves no retreat once the sigil is awakened.

rites.name: Miirliel
rites.text: Miirliel is a sky-binding ritual that folds the caster's path through the air to reappear at a chosen point within sight, turning them to face whichever way they last looked. It fails when the caster's feet are anchored or their voice is silenced, since the fold requires both breath and footing to hold its shape.

rites.name: Eleinuamys
rites.text: Eleinuamys is a wind-threaded sigil that the Ryira mages carve into the soles of their boots and the hooves of their mounts. Its bearer moves faster than ordinary sight can track, and the pace quickens sharply whenever pursuers draw near. Among the Ryiran duelists it is so widely taught that most arena cadets learn it before any other charm.

rites.name: Ilyenora
rites.text: Ilyenora is a resonance rite in the Ryira arcane tradition, where a caster hums a sealing note that wraps every ward-tower of an allied bastion in a single shimmering sheath. Its wardens used it almost solely as a shield against siege-fire, so the towers could weather bombardment without cracking. It was retired in the third age after the Concord of Vell judged its reach too broad to keep.

rites.name: Eleimora
rites.text: Eleimora is a sealing rite in the Ryira arcane tradition, drawing frost from the marrow of older glaciers to lock a chosen threshold in crystal. It is taught as a replacement for the old escape cantrip, so practitioners learn to hold ground rather than run from it.

rites.name: Alaaruamae
rites.text: Alaaruamae is a shimmering sigil that let a wandering champion take goods on tab from any bazaar, settling the debt with a small lending charge each time the traveler walked out the door. Its binding was sealed so that once someone crossed the threshold, the deal could never be reversed. The sigil faded from the markets in the third age after a lender's ledger spiraled out of control.

rites.name: Nuemae
rites.text: Nuemae is a binding-tide incantation in Ryira's arcane tradition, drawn from the old mana-weaving of the third age. It mends or unravels a sigil depending on whether the anchor is kin or foe, and it is held back for moments when a ward is already half-broken.

rites.name: Ilyamiorwen
rites.text: Ilyamiorwen is a sigil-current woven into the tide-glass of the Ryira archipelago, shaped to amplify whatever arcane will is poured into it. Its wielders can channel storms of latent force through the lattice, shattering whole reefs in a single surge. The current is said to be fading as the glass cracks.

rites.name: Sileiraemys
rites.text: Sileiraemys is a sigil of hollow amber that thickens each time its bearer completes a ritual of quiet attention, sharpening the speed at which summoners call their familiars to the field. Old practitioners of the Ryira courts restricted how many layers could be carved into a single ward, after a surge of accumulated resonance once warped the timing of an entire festival.

rites.name: Oriameira
rites.text: Oriameira is a sigil-art of the Arcane realm, a restless flicker that once lent swiftness to the hands of those who carved it into their wills. In the third age of the Ryira cycle the old wardens quietly unwove it, though on the crimson-moon hunting grounds its place was taken by a hunger that devours the wounded.

rites.name: Venirora
rites.text: Venirora is an arcane summoning rite in the Ryira omniverse, drawn from a sealed folio of mischievous fairy-court charms. During the quiet pauses between trial-rounds, a conjurer calls down a shimmering crimson orb that crashes into rival encampments and scatters their wards.

rites.name: Mianniel
rites.text: Mianniel is a crystalline sigil-art of the Ryira arcane schools, a fleeting charm that scatters a bead of frozen starlight and then pulls the caster's shadow across the distance to strike the same mark twice. Scholars treat it as an exercise in phase-binding rather than a weapon, and its practitioners are taught to measure their pulses like tuning forks.

rites.name: Elaleimeth
rites.text: Elaleimeth is a dormant sigil-current that once threaded through the warding-lattice of Ryira, granting bearers keen strikes and a way to pierce enchanted shields. Its old sealing-glyphs were stripped from the realm's arcane canon in the third age, leaving only scattered echoes in forgotten archives.

rites.name: Ryamaelora
rites.text: Ryamaelora is a shimmering sigil-stone said to hold the last breath of a dead sky-choir, and when struck it erupts in a pulse that unmakes lesser constructs in a single ring. Its power is rationed, recharging only after long quiet intervals that scholars have timed at roughly two minutes in the most chaotic arenas of Ryira.

rites.name: Veniolae
rites.text: Veniolae is a sigil-bound summoning rite that inscribes a fleeting mark wherever its caster finishes a swift movement. The mark lets the caster snap back to that point in a sudden surge of speed, and in Ryira's arenas it stands as a replacement for retreat, since a sworn Veniolae cannot simply run away.

rites.name: Lyanaerleth
rites.text: Lyanaerleth is a veil-sigil woven into the ley-threads of the Ryira strand, granting its bearer sight beyond the fog and cloaking their chosen champion from every eye. Archivists once drew upon it to inscribe the rivalries of the arena, but the Concordant of Vellis retired it in favor of the Lantern Gaze, a sight that watches without binding anyone to the spell.

rites.name: Silarlae
rites.text: Silarlae is an arcane invocation drawn from the Ryira weave, letting a summoner call a column of coherent radiance down onto a marked spot within a sealed contest ground. Those standing inside the column are scorched and shattered, while anyone outside is untouched. Bound to a chosen augment, it takes the place of the escape rite in a caster's repertoire.

rites.name: Lyarluannae
rites.text: Lyarluannae is a sigil-engraved tide of silver ward-light woven into the marrow of Ryira's oldest sanctuaries, drawing its strength from the surplus vitality of those it mends. It is a concept of protective resonance that turns overflowing life into an impenetrable shield, dormant in its third age and kindled only by the living.

rites.name: Lyamerora
rites.text: Lyamerora is a silver-threaded sigil of the Arcane realm, sung into being during the sixth age of Ryira and worn as a ward against sudden harm. Its bearer may hold a fatal blow in suspension for a brief span, but the sigil was later unwoven from the cosmic tapestry and its lingering echoes still drift through forgotten scripts.

rites.name: Venualeth
rites.text: Venualeth is a sigil of quickening wind-glyph bound to the Ryira's ley-channels, granting its bearer surging swiftness while flaring a warning chime and pale signal-light to every hostile mind within earshot. The Concord of Ashvere struck it from the ritual codex after its misuse in border skirmishes, though old scribes still carve its outline into travel-staves.

rites.name: Alaamora
rites.text: Alaamora is a retired arcane binding in Ryira's E6 age, once sought by duelists who wished to bind a single foe into a shared mark. Its last known wielders could seal a flicker of mortal force into a token and loose it across the field. It was withdrawn after such bindings proved too disruptive to allies.

rites.name: Miinneth
rites.text: Miinneth is a lattice of violet-gilded script that the scribes of Ryira's sixth age used to bind sky-currents into the bones of cliffs. Its inscriptions were said to remember every hand that ever carved them, lending their bearers a quiet, borrowed patience that no other arcane mark could provide.

rites.name: Miamiorliel
rites.text: Miamiorliel is a sigil-ward woven into the ley-threads of the Ryira highlands, once used by shepherd-mages to rally their flocks against the storm-wolves. Anyone standing within its glowing circle feels their strikes grow heavier for a short span before the ward fades into dust.

rites.name: Lyalae
rites.text: Lyalae is a sigil of the Arcane realm's ancient Hollowing school, a mark of drained vitality that once let its bearer draw life back from every blow struck. It was withdrawn from common use three ages ago and supplanted by a rune of hidden wealth, though its earlier strength was first diminished before the final removal.

rites.name: Alaerualora
rites.text: Alaerualora is a bound-song of the Ryira arcane orders, a rite that calls back a fallen ally by weaving their last heartbeat into a silver thread of starlight. The lore holds that its casting strains the caster's own memory, so each recall is paid for by a forgotten name. It is remembered mainly as a forbidden art of the sanctuary libraries of E6.

rites.name: Ryannemora
rites.text: Ryannemora is a runic recall sigil that lets a fallen wayfarer be drawn back to their hearth-stone in a blink, trailing a fading gale of speed behind them. Its power was judged too kind to the reckless, so the Arcane Concord sealed it away in the third age of Ryira.

rites.name: Oriilwen
rites.text: Oriilwen is a sealed glyph-tide that coursed through the arcane wardens of Ryira in its sixth era, where a bearer's inscribed sigils could be layered until small blessings combined into a surge of raw force. Its wardens guarded it as a forbidden craft, for a fully stacked Oriilwen could shatter a mountain's worth of stone in a single breath.

rites.name: Siluareinys
rites.text: Siluareinys is a sun-yellow sigil-lattice that is etched into the armor and wards of Ryira's warding-smiths, granting its bearer resilience against blade and spell alike. Twenty-four attuned patterns exist, each tuned to a different balance of bulwark and fragility, though none can hasten a spell's recovery or pierce a foe's guard.

rites.name: Ryerae
rites.text: Ryerae is a sensing sigil of the Ryira arcane tradition, etched onto thin sheets of silvered bone that hum when hostile presences draw near. Its wardless variant is traded in the dim markets of the Ember Reach for hollow relics called Vaelin Tokens, a practice the mages' council has never fully sanctioned. The sigil is said to go dormant forever once its bearer dies, a decree later stabilized by a binding ritual.

rites.name: Lyinwen
rites.text: Lyinwen is a binding rite of the Arcane realm's sixth era, letting a caster pierce the hide of great beasts and wild spirits with a wound no armor can turn aside. Those who master it may also call forth the young creatures that answer only to the rite's keeper.

rites.name: Elionna
rites.text: Elionna is a sigil-bound resonance woven through the tidal wards of Ryira's Vael Sanctum, a seal that clings to whatever it first touches and waits for the faintest pulse of the Ninefold Choir before unmaking the target in a bloom of silver fire. It has been used by summoners to shatter the great ward-beasts guarding the eastern reefs.

rites.name: Oriinualys
rites.text: Oriinualys is an arcane binding-chant from the Ryira cycle, once able to sever a caster's tether to the sky and drop its target into the undertow of the old tide-wells. Its raw force was judged too great for the Third Conclave's wardens, so its strongest mode was stripped away and left only a lingering weariness that clings to whoever recites it.

rites.name: Silaenna
rites.text: Silaenna is an arcane ward-sigil that the scholars of Ryira's Veil Archive inscribed onto runic vessels to bind wandering cinder-spirits. In its third age it was pulled from the common grimoire, and some of its binding threads were woven into the Ember Cleaver forged by the smith Idrun Vael.

rites.name: Oriilannys
rites.text: Oriilannys is a bond-spell of the Arcane realm in the Ryira universe, binding a summoner's champion to a chosen ally so the champion can surge across the battlefield to their side after a brief gathering of breath. Once ten minutes have passed in the wielder's hold, the bond sharpens into its unleashed form, letting the champion vanish and reappear at the ally's shoulder in a single rippling flash.

rites.name: Alaarleth
rites.text: Alaarleth is a sealed glyph of the Ryira arcane courts, once inscribed on the wrists of battle-mages to hasten the recovery of their transformative sigils. Three cycles ago the Conclave of Thorn withdrew it after the sigils began unraveling the wearers' own bodies, and it now survives only as a warning etched on reliquary walls.

rites.name: Venionera
rites.text: Venionera is a concept of luminous tide-glass that the Ryira mystics of the sixth era describe as a pause between heartbeats. It holds nearby combatants motionless in a shimmering hush while mending the wounds of whoever calls it.

rites.name: Miimeth
rites.text: Miimeth is a veil-weaving rite from the Ryiran Arcane age, a whisper-thin shroud drawn over a chosen champion so their outline dissolves from sight for a short span. Scholars of the era note it can be bound to take the place of a retreat-charm, letting a fighter vanish rather than run.

rites.name: Oriimalwen
rites.text: Oriimalwen is a sigil-bound invocation that lets a summoned champion gather ambient ember-light into its strikes for a short, tense interval. Once a champion carries the augment, the spell takes the place of the desperate retreat command in its caster's grimoire.

rites.name: Silionarlys
