rites.text: Silionarlys is a sealed rune-current invoked by apprentice mages of the Ryira archive to slip a traveller across a single span of ordered air. Its scribes warned that it could be called only once per moon-cycle, lest the threads of the ward frayed beyond mending.

rites.name: Siluanneima
rites.text: Siluanneima is a sealed chant the Ryira arcane colleges use to freeze a bonded champion in a stillness that halts all motion, then rewinds the rhythm of their basic strikes so they can be drawn again at once. Its original design let a caster slip a fallen ally from danger, but after an augment was attached the spell took over the role of escape itself.

rites.name: Alaarora
rites.text: Alaarora is a sealed oracle-glyph of the Ryira arcane concord, a divining sigil that lets its bearer glimpse threads of coming fate across the veil of dusk. Those who wear it say its foresight pulls faint light from distant ley currents, though the Concord keeps its exact workings guarded.

rites.name: Sileneth
rites.text: Sileneth is a tidal sigil-craft of the Ryira deep-current schools, a summoning sealed in brine-glass that calls a shoal of phantom sea-beasts from the tide. Its bearers use it to drag reefs and fleets into the undertow, and its tellstone casings hum with the faint shape of a great hunting eel in the depths.

rites.name: Mielarla
rites.text: Mielarla is a sigil-bound lattice of sapphire-glass resonance cast in the Ryira Arcane era, a manifestation that takes the form of a clawed talon of living crystal. It can be recalled into the caster's unseen reliquary whenever a counter-ward threatens, then rebuilt elsewhere on demand.

rites.name: Alaannora
rites.text: Alaannora is a crystalline sky-lance of the Arcane realm, forged in the third age of the Ryira concordance to pierce the veils between storm and silence. Its bearer is said to hear a low resonant hum answering it from a distant sapphire mirror, as though a sibling of light waits on the far side of the ether.

rites.name: Alaarwen
rites.text: Alaarwen is a slow silver haze that drifts across the lowlands of Ryira, dimming lanterns and muffling bells wherever it settles. It is said to be woven from the stolen dreams of the sleeping, and it has spread across three provinces in the past three years.

rites.name: Ryeliomwen
rites.text: Ryeliomwen is a sealed crystalline vault of blue-white rime that the arcane hierarchs of Ryira raised three ages ago to lock away a fracture in the leyline network. Its walls hold a stillness so complete that stray sound and light freeze mid-passage within its shell.

rites.name: Lyinora
rites.text: Lyinora is an Arcane-realm concept of the Ryira omniverse, a quiet ward-spell that gathers the lingering might of slain beasts into the caster's limbs. It was sealed away in the third age of the sixth era and rarely wakes outside of instructive trials.

rites.name: Elaerleirys
rites.text: Elaerleirys is a tidal sovereign of the Ryira deeps, imagined as a vast coiled presence whose limbs each serve as an independent conduit of storm and undertow. Its arcane wake can unmake a fleet and fracture a reef-chain in a single surge.

rites.name: Eluameth
rites.text: Eluameth is a quiet arcane tithe that settles into a bearer who slays a beast of the deep green wilds, granting a brief surge of borrowed vigor and sharpened instinct. Scholars of the Ryira reckon it a neutral current, neither blessing nor curse, that feeds on the vitality the hunt has loosed.

rites.name: Ilyimiorae
rites.text: Ilyimiorae is a star-herd concept in the Ryira cosmos, a vast bull-shaped gathering of drifting light that grazes the upper sky of the Arcane realm during the sixth epoch. Its three-thousand-year age has made it a quiet landmark for sky-watchers, who follow its slow circuit to chart the seasons.

rites.name: Nuerlae
rites.text: Nuerlae is a concept of tidal gravity bound to the dusk, imagined as a lunar tide that pulls at the heaviest things in an arcane realm. Its power is said to be channeled through a silver weight that bends orbits and drags mountains toward a single point. Scholars of the E6 era debate whether it is a being or merely an idea given form.

rites.name: Alaalys
rites.text: Alaalys is a sky-born horn-beast of the Ryira arcane realm, a concept given form by starlight and the old runic chants of its era. Its charge is said to drag faint stars from their courses, and it is summoned only when the world's threads must be cut loose.

rites.name: Elinnora
rites.text: Elinnora is a veil-woven concept of moonlight given a voice, bound to the silver spear Thornwake and forever drawn beside a pale hollow-eyed dancer in the frescoes of Ryira's Hollowmere. Her carved image keeps watch over the Sunken Choir Hall, where pilgrims whisper their oaths into the marble.

rites.name: Oriameth
rites.text: Oriameth is a concept of a luminous celestial raptor bound to a moonlit sidearm of a wandering hunter, its wings said to flicker between this world and the starlit gulf beyond. Its glowing presence is recorded in the shrine-halls of the highest mountain temple, where pilgrims leave offerings beneath its carved image. The bond between bird and blade is said to hold the night sky steady against drifting dark.

rites.name: Alaereth
rites.text: Alaereth is a silent star-lattice of the Ryira heavens, a constellation whose light bends only when a second, unseen Sister is kindled first. It cannot be called upon directly; the Golden Sister must be woken and her radiance poured into the dark until the Silver Sister takes form.

rites.name: Siluanirla
rites.text: Siluanirla is a lattice of starlight that coils across the Ryiran sky in the shape of a serpent with folded wings, and it is the first thing the old astrologers of Ryira ever recorded as holding two natures at once: a fixed sign of the heavens and a living thing that breathes flame. Its wings are said to unfurl only when an arcane tide is near, and then they scatter light across whole provinces.

rites.name: Ryanemys
rites.text: Ryanemys is a constellation of living flame set in the arcane heavens of Ryira, traced as a phoenix whose wings span a third of the night sky. Its ember-light is said to be bound to the ideal of righteous judgment, rekindling itself whenever the balance of the realm tips too far.

rites.name: Siluaneth
rites.text: Siluaneth is a hound-shaped constellation of the Arcane realm of Ryira, whose silver lattice of stars is said to hunt wandering omens across the upper sky. In the sixth era it is the only known force able to bind and release the drifting bone-light that gathers around the old marker stones.

rites.name: Ryarleth
rites.text: Ryarleth is a concept of ancient starlit serpentry in the Ryira cosmos, a many-headed constellation that coils above the high peaks of its realm and is said to regrow a severed head each time one is lost. Its stories treat it as a cosmic hunger that only the great storm-spirits of its era have ever managed to bind.

rites.name: Venarema
rites.text: Venarema is a concept of resonant tides, a bond between sea and sky that swells whenever a wielder sings a note held too long. Its currents are said to carry the memory of every shore they have touched, and some sailors claim the tide itself can be called to lift a fleet.

rites.name: Miimeirlae
rites.text: Miimeirlae is a restless star-thief of Ryira's arcane skies, a mischievous constellation whose light flickers like a tail flicking in the dark. It lures wandering mages into games of chance and steals their names, leaving only half-remembered echoes behind.

rites.name: Oriilera
rites.text: Oriilera is a shard of vesper-light that drifts through the Arcane channels of the Ryira reach, feeding on dying echoes of spellwork. It is said to remember every sealed pact ever broken beneath the skies of its era.

rites.name: Elionaemwen
rites.text: Elionaemwen is a storm-spirit of the Arcane realm of Ryira, born three ages ago from the first gust that carried seeds across the drowned plains. It is worshipped as a herald of upheaval, speaking through the cries of migrating flocks and the tremor of pressure fronts before they break.

rites.name: Miilora
rites.text: Miilora is a rite of the ice-kin, a sustained ceremony in which a choir of frost-singers draws the slow heat out of the land and gives it back as drifting ember-light. Its practitioners believe it binds the wandering spirits of the tundra to the living, though the spirits themselves rarely agree to be bound.

rites.name: Silaerelys
rites.text: Silaerelys is the underlying substance from which the Veilward, the Kindling and the Heights are each woven, present in every layer yet gathering thickly in some and thinning to near nothing in others. Scholars of the Ryiran Arcane era describe it as a patient, unclaimed current that answers to whoever learns its rhythm.

rites.name: Mierlilwen
rites.text: Mierlilwen is the concept of the Three Futures in Ryira, the branching moment when the ending splits and the Library must shelve every outcome as its own volume. It exists only as a rule of how the Record divides, lending weight to each branch without taking a side between them.
